_about: The kit's research database: SOURCES (what exists + its terms), QUESTIONS (what a design needs), FINDINGS (answers, each quoted from a PERMITTED source). Rules + how to dispatch research: references/README.md. Validate: node checks/claims-references-are-sound.mjs. A town's state is DERIVED from its own geography — never listed here.

findings.question: q-island-min-size
findings.where: §11.1.1 Key Design Features, p.11-20; Visibility, p.11-21
findings.quote: Channelizing islands can be raised or flush with the pavement. … Raised islands have been found to be more effective than flush painted islands at reducing nighttime collisions, because they are easier to see.
